title: Halo raw-blend fix (review r1) has no pin — no test fixture draws a warning halo
evidence: view.odin:848 "raw := col // the halo's blend base — warning colors NEVER recede (review r1: the halo was dragged ~37% toward canvas with the receded col)"; view.odin:921 "u8(f32(raw.r) * 0.57 + f32(halo.r) * 0.43),"; halo gate view.odin:914-915 "lvl := bundle_congestion_level(topo, bundles, crisis, u32(bi)) / if lvl != .None {"; bundle_congestion_level reads only "return crisis.pipe_congestion[ps]" / "return .None"; palcheck.odin:923 fixture builds the crisis via "pp.crisis_trigger(&state, 1000, 0, 0, .Saturated_Bundle, state.bundles.pipe_bundle[psa], 0, 10)" and core/crisis.odin:285-306 crisis_trigger writes no pipe_congestion — both fixture bundles read .None, so no halo renders in section 7.
detail: Reverting raw→col in both halo blends fails no unit test and no palcheck leg; the fixture never draws a halo. Golden coverage is at best incidental, so the telegraph-canon fix is unpinned.
recommended_fix: Add a palcheck §7 leg: set crisis.pipe_congestion on the non-involved bundle's pipe, pixel-scan its halo against the raw-tier-blended hex (receded blend must be absent).

title: Dublin board recede path ships with zero coverage anywhere
evidence: dublin.odin:360 "col.a = u8(f32(col.a) * crisis_recede_scale(recede))"; dublin.odin:365 "edge.a = u8(90 * crisis_recede_scale(recede))"; only Dublin demo is demos/dublin_board.dem ("capture at 30000ms / capture at 90000ms"), and the PR body states "The dublin@90s golden caught this empirically: era-3 growth fires a pool crisis there" — Pool_Exhaustion yields factor 0, so the recede lines never execute; palcheck §7's fixture uses the procedural/sprite path (no map_source=Dublin, no board).
detail: Deleting both crisis_recede_scale calls from dublin_node_block_draw leaves every test green — a shipped behavior change (spec: 'the Dublin street blocks' recede) with no test at any level.
recommended_fix: Extend the §7 fixture (or a golden) to a Dublin-map board with a Saturated_Bundle crisis, scanning a non-involved block's wash/edge alpha against the receded value.
